svg.title: In particular the diagonal alias matrix d3 μ ⊗1Ch has nuclear norm at most 8hJ0. This is the three-massive-arc trace bound used inside the ninth-power regulator. Here are the frames in which it is used. Let TL(p) have entries L−2eipl·exδαβ, with row x, α and column l, β. The finite character sum shows that it is unitary at real p; its explicit inverse is the opposite-phase character matrix. On the fixed complex strip the two matrices have operator norms at most e4/128, by separating their real unitary Fourier factor from the diagonal complex phases. Furnishing an alias symbol means conjugating its diagonal alias blocks by these two matrices. Thus its three-arc nuclear bound is at most
